synth.notes:
Arrows move the player 3 cells; it may only land on colours {1,4} and stay inside the portal bbox (colours 2 and 15 block it).
If the move would land on a token, the player stays and the token is kicked: the chain slides 1 cell per tick, absorbs tokens it touches, crosses {1,4,15}, and stops at other colours, the bbox, the player, or a socket interior (inset 1) it does not fit.
Drawing: tokens are colour e with a colour-5 centre; the player has a colour-0 centre and draws any side touching a token all 0.
Click on a token: the player takes that token's rect; the old player stays as an inactive token (husk) with its centre set to 4.
HUD row 63: (n+1)//2 zeros from the right, n = actions this level; n is carried only when the incoming frame matches the last returned one, otherwise n = 2*zeros (stateless run 15/29, all misses in the HUD row). Unconfirmed: a token that fits a socket, actions 5 and 7.
